topic: Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit (CGEB) replaced the GST/HST credit in July 2026 (25% increase over the GST credit for five years, 2026–2031); July 2026–June 2027 maximums: $679 single, $890 couple, + $234 per child under 19; paid quarterly (July, October, January, April); reduced by 5% of 2025 adjusted family net income above $46,432

example.note: example (not a CRA rule): Amira and Ben, couple with two children under 19, 2025 adjusted family net income ≤ $46,432 → $890 + 2 × $234 = $1,358 for July 2026–June 2027, paid as 4 quarterly payments of $339.50. At $56,432 (10,000 over the threshold): 5% × $10,000 = $500 less → $858.

spoken.thr: forty-six thousand four hundred and thirty-two dollars

sources.amounts: canada.ca CRA 'How much you can get – CGEB' (July 2026–June 2027, 2025 base year): up to $679 single, $890 married/common-law, $234 per eligible child under 19; base $445 + single additional $234; phase-out threshold $46,432 (payment amounts page)
sources.increase: Department of Finance releases June/July 2026: CGEB is a 25% increase over the GST credit, for 5 years (2026–2031); first enriched quarterly payment July 2026
sources.phaseout: Budget 2026 tax measures: 5% phase-out on 2025 adjusted family net income above $46,432
sources.dates: CRA payment dates / payments chart: four quarterly issuances July 2026, October 2026, January 2027, April 2027 (July 3 and October 5, 2026)

unverified: RC4210 guide shows lower maxima ($520/$589/$231); CRA 'How much' page and payments chart ($679/$890/$234) used. www.canada.ca not fetchable from this session
